name: Facet
text: Choose a single high-contrast dark theme with adjustable saturation and font size for Excava’s interface. This maximizes visibility and liveliness by reducing eye strain in low light while keeping the data sharp and interactive. The trade-off is slightly slower rendering for users on low-end devices, but the gain in clarity and enjoyment outweighs it for our scre.

name: Pane
text: A single high-contrast dark theme risks excluding users who need *low* contrast for readability—like those with light-sensitive migraines or retinal conditions. Instead, offer a *system-preference* toggle (light/dark) with adjustable saturation and font size; this covers all edge cases without sacrificing core visibility. Settle it with a 24-hour user test: measure task completion time and comfort ratings across both themes.
